source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Concerns considered relevant mainly during the client's final days of life alone, rather than persisting throughout the whole caregiving journey","B":"Carrying fairly minimal unique stress overall compared with other, more typical everyday caregiving situations that people commonly face","C":"A condition generally considered unrelated to the ongoing demands of the caregiving role itself, even over an extended period of caring for someone","D":"Physical, emotional, and financial strain related to the often intensive and prolonged demands of cancer caregiving, warranting recognition and connection to support resources"}}
source_row.rationale: Cancer caregiver burden may include physical, emotional, and financial strain related to the often intensive and prolonged demands of cancer caregiving throughout the illness trajectory, not only in the final days, warranting nursing recognition and connection to appropriate support resources throughout the cancer care journey.
source_row.source_detail: Comprehensive Recognition of Cancer Caregiver Burden
